title: Create a welcome message within an ad account
content_data:
Use this endpoint to create a welcome message in your ad account. Each welcome message will be saved in the welcome message library of the ad account for future use in [TikTok Direct Messaging Ads](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1774482992153601). ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/creative/auto_message/create/ **Method** POST **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1738373164380162).| |Content-Type {Required}|string|Request message type.
Allowed format: `application/json`. | ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |--- |--- |--- | | advertiser_id {Required} | string | Advertiser ID. | | auto_message_type {Required} | string | The type of automatic message to greet people with when they start a conversation with you.

Enum value:
  • `WELCOME_MESSAGE`: welcome message. A welcome message is a message that is automatically sent to welcome people to the conversation after they tap on your ad.
| | welcome_message {+Conditional} | object | Required when `auto_message_type` is `WELCOME_MESSAGE`.

Information about the welcome message. | #| title {+Conditional} | string | Required when `welcome_message` is passed.

The name of the welcome message.
You can specify a unique name to distinguish between different welcome messages within the welcome message library of your ad account. | #| content {+Conditional} | string | Required when `welcome_message` is passed.

The greeting within the welcome message.

Length limit: 200 characters.

Example: `Hi, thanks for contacting us. How can we help you?` | #| suggested_questions {+Conditional} | object[] | Required when `welcome_message` is passed.

A list of suggested questions for customers to tap.
A suggested question is a frequently asked question displayed at the beginning of a chat. When the user selects a suggested question, the user will automatically receive the corresponding preset answer.

Size range: 1-3. | ##| question {+Conditional} | string | Required when `welcome_message` is passed.

A frequently asked question to help users start a conversation.

Length limit: 70 characters. | ##| answer {+Conditional} | string | Required when `welcome_message` is passed.

The preset answer that will be automatically sent when a user selects the question.

Length limit: 500 characters. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request POST 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/creative/auto_message/create/' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \ --data '{ "advertiser_id":"{{advertiser_id}}", "auto_message_type":"WELCOME_MESSAGE", "welcome_message": { "title": "{{title}}", "content": "{{content}}", "suggested_questions": [ { "question": "{{question}}", "answer": "{{answer}}" }, { "question": "{{question}}", "answer": "{{answer}}" }, { "question": "{{question}}", "answer": "{{answer}}" } ] } }' (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return Code](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message|string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id |string|The log ID of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | |data |object|Returned data.| # |auto_message_id|string| The ID of the automatic message.| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "auto_message_id": "{{auto_message_id}}" } } (/code) ```
